evidence.quote: Although protecting financial stability is germane to numerous areas, including monetary policy, today I will focus on some aspects of its relevance for financial regulation.
All this suggests to me that the initial list of firms designated under section 113 of the Dodd-Frank Act should not be a lengthy one.
But, particularly with respect to the shadow financial system, there is much that remains to be done.

parsed.rationale: The speech addresses systemic-risk regulation, the designation of firms under Dodd-Frank and shadow banking, and does not discuss rates, inflation, growth or asset purchases. It carries no monetary policy signal.
